This effect is currently being investigated through phase II trials in patients with refractory metastatic breast cancer, where 2ME has demonstrated good tolerability. The combination of 2ME with chemotherapeutic agents may lead to a new clinically relevant treatment regimen for hormone-dependent cancer.

However, more research is needed to confirm these findings and fully understand the effects of this combination on chemotherapy dosages in ovarian cancer patients.

In summary, while 2-methoxyestradiol can potentially reduce the dosage of certain chemotherapeutics by enhancing their effectiveness at lower concentrations, further investigation and larger-scale studies are required to fully assess its efficacy in ovarian cancer treatment.
